description: This file defines the ArrayLoader class which is part of the Twig templating engine. It loads templates stored in an array, providing methods to set templates, retrieve source code, check existence, generate cache keys, and determine freshness. It is mainly used for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: ArrayLoader
classes.description: Loads templates from an array. Implements methods for template management such as setting a template, fetching source context, checking existence, cache key generation, and freshness verification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the loader with an optional array of templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets or overrides a template by name.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source code and context for a given template name.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a template with the specified name exists.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a cache key string for the specified template.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks whether the template is considered fresh based on the provided timestamp.
